summary: My soul pours out small talk in broken versus of poetry shattering niceties introductions into my true through hyperbolic lies and meaning lying within a spell of spilled elixir truth capturing falsehood #smallpoems

body_html:
My soul pours
out small talk
in broken versus
of
poetry shattering
niceties

introductions
into my true
through
hyperbolic lies
and meaning
lying within

a
spell
of spilled elixir
truth capturing
falsehood
#smallpoems
